# traceMiku Improvement Roadmap

> Centerpiece is the **trace-aware decompiler**. The single most damning fact, verified across many findings: the "trace-enhanced" pipeline is **functionally static**. `routes/llil_pipeline.rs:192` calls `decompile_trace(&insns, &[], &fn_.name)` with an **empty** `TraceContext` slice, and inside `il_pipeline.rs` (`decompile_trace`, lines 98-197) `contexts` is read **only** at line 173 to sum `exec_count`. Every runtime value the trace records — register values, memory contents, branch directions, loop counts — is discarded before lifting. The project's own test even documents this: `tests/il_pipeline_tests.rs:341` asserts only `total_exec_count` with the comment "This proves contexts only affect total_exec_count, nothing else."

## 1. Executive Summary

1. **Wire trace data into the decompiler.** The headline differentiator is a no-op. Build real `TraceContext`s in the route and consume them in lowering. Everything else in the decompiler roadmap depends on this single plumbing fix (`routes/llil_pipeline.rs:192`, `il_pipeline.rs:98-197`).
2. **Concretize observed values + prune never-taken branches.** Once contexts flow, the two biggest readability wins are (a) folding observed runtime values into the IL (`il_pipeline.rs:135` constfold is static-only) and (b) linearizing the single executed path to flatten OLLVM/VM dispatch (`branch_taken` at `il_pipeline.rs:46` is declared but never set or read). These are exactly what the literature (Yadegari S&P'15, SAILR USENIX'24) calls the trace-aware advantage.
3. **Add HTTP compression** — one `CompressionLayer` before `axum::serve` (`main.rs:79`) is a ~2-effort broad latency win on CFG SVG (cap 1.5MB), IL text, and static assets, all 5-10x compressible; tower-http is already a dep (`rust/Cargo.toml:27`).
4. **Finish the HLIL structurer.** It emits only `While`/`DoWhile` — no `For`, `Switch`, `Break`, `Continue` despite `HlilOp` variants and constructors existing (`hlil/pass_restructure.rs:350-354`). This directly violates the CLAUDE.md "eliminate goto" mandate.
5. **Refresh stale docs.** `TODO.md` is ~16 days and one milestone behind (no crypto, spawn-hook, or frida 17.9.11); a 53MB vendored frida-server is undocumented with a dead cross-reference link; `AGENTS.md`/`REFERENCES.md` describe a 2-route decompiler that no longer exists.

---

## 2. Trace-Aware Decompiler (Centerpiece)

The decompiler has a complete static three-layer pipeline (LLIL→MLIL→HLIL, real SSA with phi in `pass_phi.rs`, Ghidra 6-phase passes, dominators, restructuring) — but it is **starved of trace data**. The roadmap below is ordered so each step unlocks the next.

### Phase 0 — Plumbing (prerequisite for everything else)
Nothing trace-aware is possible until `TraceContext` actually reaches lowering.

- **`contexts-discarded-empty-slice` / `decompile-uses-empty-trace-contexts` / `pipeline-route-passes-empty-trace-context`** (all the same root cause). In `routes/llil_pipeline.rs` the record loop (lines 117-181) already walks `start..=end`; build a `Vec<TraceContext>` aligned to the deduped `insns` and pass it at line 192 instead of `&[]`. Populate `exec_count` from `inner.index.pc_to_idxs[pc].len()`, `regs_before/after` from `rec.reg(...)`, `branch_taken` by comparing the next executed record's PC to fall-through. Fix the eval example too (`examples/decompile_trace.rs:84` also passes `&[]`).
- **Caveat (verified):** the loop dedups to unique `(pc,inst)` and `break`s at the first `blr`/`ret` (lines 146/156). So a context per unique PC can hold only ONE observed value; for loop bodies pick a documented representative (first execution) or aggregate. The boundary-truncation must be reworked if you want full function coverage (`dedup-destroys-execution-order-and-loops`).
- Even with lowering unchanged, this immediately makes `total_exec_count` and `trace_contexts` correct in the API response (today always 0/empty) and unblocks hot/cold annotation.

### Phase 1 — Value concretization (the #1 readability win, impact 5)
- **`no-concrete-value-folding`** (`il_pipeline.rs:135`). All folding is compile-time-only. Add a concretization pass over SSA LLIL: for each def whose observed value is identical across all executions (`distinct_count==1`), substitute the concrete immediate and annotate `/* observed = 0x... */`. The primitive `collect_observed_values` + `is_const()` already exist (`pass_uidf.rs`) but are wired only into `/api/llil-render` as a side `uidf` JSON field — not folded into IL. This is what turns opaque decrypted keys, loaded globals, and computed pointers into readable constants. *Literature: rr (USENIX ATC'17) is the canonical "analysis over a concrete recorded execution" anchor.*
- **`memshadow-loaded-values-unused-by-decompiler`** (`memshadow.rs`, `il_pipeline.rs:39-42`). MemShadow **already** reconstructs load AND store values with a byte map and is cached on shared state, but the decompiler never reads `inner.memshadow_if_ready()`. Wire it: render `[x8+0x10]=0x1234 (= "abc")` for loads/stores. Pure wiring, no record-format change.

### Phase 2 — Path specialization / OLLVM de-flattening (impact 5, the obfuscation lever)
This is the highest-value trace-only capability and directly serves the libsgmainso target.
- **`no-path-pruning-from-branch-taken` / `no-path-specialization-pruning` / `no-path-specialized-decompile`** (`hlil/pass_restructure.rs:109-210` build_cfg). The restructurer rebuilds a full static CFG and never consults executed edges. Derive the executed-edge set from consecutive record PCs, prune never-taken edges before structuring, and collapse the flattening dispatcher (loop header switching on a state var) into a linear sequence. Annotate dropped branches `// pruned: not taken in trace`. *Literature: **Yadegari et al. S&P'15** (trace+taint deflattening) is the exact match — traceMiku already has both a trace and a taint engine (`taint.rs`). **SAILR USENIX'24** structuring applied to the single executed path makes goto elimination far easier than the static case.*
- **`indirect-jump-br-not-resolved`** (`routes/llil_pipeline.rs:288-298`). `blr` targets are resolved for text annotation; `br xN` (the OLLVM/VM dispatcher) gets no target. Two deliverables: (small) record `br_resolutions[reg]=record[idx+1].pc` and annotate `br xN -> 0x<target> /* observed */`; (large) feed resolved edges into the CFG for de-flattening.
- **`indirect-calls-not-resolved-into-il`** (`il_pipeline.rs:7` doc over-promises). Fold resolved `blr` targets into real `Call(target)` IL/CFG edges instead of regex text replace, so HLIL structuring and the call tree see them.

### Phase 3 — Observed types & struct recovery (impact 4)
- **`no-struct-recovery-from-observed-memory` / `struct-recovery-base-offset-only` / `trace-driven-type-and-struct-inference`** (`pass_struct_recovery.rs`, `mlil/lower.rs:321-371`). Struct detection matches only `base + non-negative-const` — no scaled index `base + i*scale`, rejects negative (frame-pointer) offsets, ignores observed addresses. Cluster memory accesses by **observed runtime base pointer** to recover real field offsets/widths/nested pointers. HLIL even has an unused `ArrayIndex` node ready (`hlil/expr.rs:46`). *Literature: **ReSym CCS'24** (Distinguished Paper) — consistency-aggregated struct recovery; trace supplies the real base addresses ReSym infers.*
- **`no-type-inference-from-observed-values` / `no-value-range-type-inference`** (`pass_type_inference.rs`, `llil/pass_typelat.rs`). Type inference is purely usage-based; the live LLIL lattice has no signedness at all. Classify from observed value sets: bool (`{0,1}`), narrow int (high-32 never set → i32), pointer (value in mapped module range via `symbols::build_from_trace`), char* (deref to printable bytes). *Literature: extend **retypd PLDI'16** (already cited) with observed value-range/pointer constraints; **DIRTY USENIX'22** as the rename/retype baseline.*

### Phase 4 — Branch bias, loop counts, multi-call differencing
- **`no-branch-direction-or-loop-counts-in-il`** (`il_pipeline.rs:128-131`, `builder.rs:186` `not_taken_count: 0` hardcoded). Surface observed taken/not-taken counts and real loop trip counts (CFG `EdgeMeta.count` already has back-edge counts — largely a rendering task).
- **`no-multi-trace-differencing`** (`llil_pipeline.rs:77-99`). Compare the same PC across multiple recorded calls to classify each value as Constant vs InputDependent (recovers parameters; prevents over-specialized folding). Depends on Phase 1.

### Phase 5 — Structurer correctness (shared with §5)
- **`residual-gotos-weak-convergence`** (`hlil/pass_restructure.rs:814-827`). `check_convergence` is one-hop only, so multi-block if/else arms degrade to goto tails. Replace with immediate-post-dominator merge selection (post-dominators = `compute_dominators` on reverse CFG + virtual exit). *Literature: SAILR / Phoenix "No-More-Gotos" ipostdom rule.*
- **`dominators-on2-and-irreducible-unhandled`** (`hlil/pass_restructure.rs:228-265`). O(n²) BTreeSet dominators duplicated in llil + hlil; irreducible regions fall to flat gotos. Trace-prune-to-executed-path first (collapses multi-entry → reducible), then one shared Cooper-Harvey-Kennedy idom routine.

### TraceIR / LLM surface (optional, can stay hidden)
The LLM path is opt-in and may be hidden during latency work, so lower priority — but cheap wins exist:
- **`traceir-block-samples-only-5-regs-first-exec`** (`render.rs:179-189`): LLM sees only x0-x3+sp at first exec. Add per-instruction value annotations.
- **`traceir-no-memshadow-in-rendered-prompt`** (`render.rs:283-292`): observed memory only reaches the LLM for VM hex dumps. Add an "Observed memory" section.
- **`traceir-loop-bodies-not-folded`** (`render.rs:13-151`): `LoopIR`/`InductionVarIR` exist but `render_func_md` emits no loops section AND `builder.rs` never populates them. *Literature: **LLM4Decompile EMNLP'24** Ref-mode (refine decompiler output) + re-executability metric; **SLaDe CGO'24** (ARM-focused, local).*
- **`traceir-no-fewshot-exemplar`**, **`traceir-no-structured-output`**: prompt has no worked example and no JSON schema mode.

| 2 | **`decode()` clones DecodedInsn on every cache hit** | `disasm/cache.rs:30,39` clones 2 Strings + `Vec<String>` per call across ~27 per-record loops (taint/index/memshadow/cfg). | 3 | **Eager CFG/FunctionIndex/symbol build blocks startup** | `state.rs:186,195,196` run synchronously in `load()` before listener binds (`main.rs:73`), no size gate — unlike size-gated MemShadow (`state.rs:26,211`). Gate on `trace.len()`, move to warmer thread | 3 |
| 4 | **`/api/llil/pipeline` recomputes full-trace call analysis uncached** | `llil_pipeline.rs:203-207` → `analyze_calls` scans `0..trace.len()` (`call_analysis.rs:82`) every request with `include_call_analysis`; no cache. Memoize in `OnceLock` like `call_tree()` (`state.rs:489`) | 2 |

| 8 | **`trace_ir_cache` unbounded full TopIR per option-set** | `state.rs:91,361-378` never evicts; cap to 1-2 entry LRU. (Other caches are mostly key-bounded — scope down) | 2 |
| 9 | **TopIR rebuilt per non-default decompile option; calltree built twice** | `state.rs:361-402`, `builder.rs:408` + `builder.rs:270`. Hoist shared `CallNode` (already in `state.rs:77` OnceLock) + first_idx map into `build_trace_ir` | 3 |

| 3 | **Value-set / range view** for a reg or stack slot (angr VSA, but exact) | No `value_set`/VSA anywhere; `/api/reg-timeline` is raw, not aggregated. Compute distinct/min/max/histogram/classifier; feeds type inference. Reuse `build_reg_timeline_range` workers | 3 |

## 7. Literature to Adopt

The owner explicitly named SAILR; the trace-aware deobfuscation cluster is the highest value-per-citation gap (traceMiku records per-block concrete I/O, so synthesis is *strictly easier* than every paper's threat model).

| Title | Year | Technique | Improves (file) | URL |
|-------|------|-----------|-----------------|-----|
| **SAILR** | 2024 | Compiler-aware structuring; drastically fewer gotos; in angr | `hlil/pass_restructure.rs` (cites pre-2024 Phoenix/DREAM) + Phase 2/5 path-specialized structuring | https://www.usenix.org/conference/usenixsecurity24/presentation/basque |
| **Yadegari et al.** | 2015 | Trace + taint deobfuscation; deflattens VM/CFF along executed path | Phase 2 dispatcher linearization; `taint.rs` already exists | https://ieeexplore.ieee.org/document/7163058 |
| **ReSym** | 2024 | LLM + Prolog consistency for variable/struct recovery | `pass_struct_recovery.rs`, type inference (Phase 3) | https://dl.acm.org/doi/10.1145/3658644.3690294 |
| **Syntia** | 2017 | MCTS program synthesis over I/O (MBA/VM handlers) | `mlil/deobfuscate.rs` (header admits no MBA/CFF) | https://www.usenix.org/conference/usenixsecurity17/technical-sessions/presentation/blazytko |
| **Xyntia** | 2021 | ILS black-box synthesis — fast successor to Syntia | `mlil/deobfuscate.rs` (per-block, fits spawn_blocking) | https://dl.acm.org/doi/10.1145/3460120.3484812 |
| **QSynth** | 2020 | Offline-table greybox synthesis (lowest latency) | `mlil/deobfuscate.rs` cache-friendly variant | https://archive.bar/pdfs/bar2020-preprint9.pdf |
| **LLM4Decompile** | 2024 | LLM decompile; Ref-mode refines existing output; re-executability metric | TraceIR/`/api/dec/*`; eval tool metric | https://arxiv.org/abs/2403.05286 |
| **SLaDe** | 2024 | 200M ARM-focused local decompiler + type inference | TraceIR LLM path (ARM64, single-user/local) | https://arxiv.org/abs/2305.12520 |
| **DIRTY** | 2022 | Transformer rename/retype of decompiler output | rename/set-type UX, type inference | https://www.usenix.org/conference/usenixsecurity22/presentation/chen-qibin |
| **Mozilla rr** | 2017 | Record-and-replay; time-travel debugging | Frames the whole trace-aware thesis; reverse-stepping feature | https://www.usenix.org/conference/atc17/technical-sessions/presentation/ocallahan |
| Nova | 2025 | Hierarchical-attention assembly LLM | TraceIR serialization / model option | https://arxiv.org/abs/2311.13721 |

**REFERENCES.md edits:** add three section clusters — (1) LLM decompilation (LLM4Decompile/SLaDe/Nova/DIRTY/ReSym), (2) Deobfuscation/Synthesis (Syntia/Xyntia/QSynth/Loki/Yadegari), (3) modern Structuring (SAILR alongside DREAM/Phoenix); add rr to the DBI section; annotate retypd/TIE with the trace-driven extension direction; add a short framing paragraph stating the trace-aware thesis (concretize values, prune never-executed paths, 100% indirect resolution, observed-address struct recovery, CFF linearization).
